Content: Going out into a field, I can actually see the arms of the Milky Way. Seeing it in its colors, red, blues, purples. I hear that there used to be a green awful glow coming out of the cities, but we don't do that anymore.
Physicists, engineers, ecologists have a keen understanding of their breath, their body, and the interconnection of humans, the planet and cosmos. Their training is in spiritual practices.
We share our learnings of right relationships with other residents across the milky way, and learn from them
People will be connected to themselves and others, nature and the stars etc.
People would remember and be taught how to navigate by the stars. We understand that we all look up to the same sky.
We remember and honor of our interconnectedness every day. Honoring death helps people remember that they come from each other. And that we come from the stars.

I visualize being in the sky as an ancestor and looking down. Seeing generations hand in hand. Treating others as they want to be treated. Accepting, nonjudgmental. Give peace a chance. Enough for all. No borders. Everything is done with love.
Spirit was right again. Devotion of hope.
We all understand our relationship to the universe – and to one another. People have a clear sense of that relationship and responsibility to one another.
We listen to nature spirits. People have become experts in hearing the teachings of various animals and plants who help build local communities and holistic organization and governance.
Freedom is written in the map of stars.
We will rise with the sun or the moon and every day think it necessary to find our souls rooted in the earth, connected to all the souls and so we flourish together.
Light moves through constellations of 7 reverberating our interconnectedness.
People tend to their spiritual selves and transmute basic values by proverbs, sayings, and truths.

Song: No 0ne is getting left behind this time, no one is getting left behind, no one is getting left behind this time, we get there together or never get there at all 
Spirit is seen in each other, in the flowers, in the water ~ the rivers, the lakes, the ocean, the rain, in the fruit, in the soil, in the seeds, in the creatures, in the wind in the trees, in the birds, in the bees, in the insects, the bats, the worms, the hands that tend us. Love is the currency.
New forms of intelligence. Oceanic Consciousness. One united, yet different planet.

All spirituality is treated as  sacred, and practiced by anyone desiring a deeper connection with the collecting beingness.  Churches, temples, mosques, etc are no more and the buildings are providing community housing.
Humans live across the universe.
Life-giving is sacred. Birth is sacred. Earth is sacred. Children are sacred.
We have sacred spaces that are not infiltrated by humans. We accept the responsibility to protect the sacred and important. This brings back our connectedness and intuition.
Sea Turtle: sacred being represents always knowing who we are and remembering our roots. We are interconnected.

People are able to be with spirit and that is the love between people. That they nourish the spirit that is magic. They recognize that this magic enables them to live in a good way with others. They practice facilitating this magic in schools and institutions. They carry on this magic to resist what is not right, to protect the spirit and that is the love between people.
We recover our spiritual power and reclaim our practices that connect us with the universe, we understand the magical beings we are, we learn to heal with our hands, we reconnect with our divinity.

We are benefiting from the proliferation of spiritual traditions of all kinds.  The natural world is no longer considered a resource.  Spiritual traditions would help people to understand that we are interconnected, interdependent, and that the natural world is not a resource.  The Chickadee doesn’t wake up and ask what to do today. We Chickadee all day long.

People are connected to the elements that nature consists of, air, water, earth, and fire.  These elements are understood by all spiritual traditions in their unique ways.  We have separated the word resource from nature.  When it’s not a resource, we are a part of it and it gives back to us, mutuality.
Now that all of our actions are based in prayer, there is less of a need for a church, and many aspects of organized religion.
Wisdom and spirituality show that God is in all people. Every child is told the story of their name. Interconnectedness is strong. There are relationships between Earth and humans.
Feminine and masculine are in balance.
We met and continue to meet - at an extraordinary inflection point or fulcrum point in America and the world. And at our first gathering the first feeling is that of community!

As we believe we are all one, we stop othering and get busy belonging and thriving. 

We find abundance in our Oneness and no longer compete for resources. We know that the universe will provide when we are in harmony with the Earth and with each other. Race,  ethnicity, and economic status are not the salient (dominant) features of being in collective spaces.
Aliens reach out to us because we have reached maturation and are considered ready to be part of the galactic community. The entire universe is shared.

Just enough – not too much or little
Spirit leads
Magic has returned, we ride dragons
Earth rebirth

The sky emits a powerful energy, so much so that visionary beings are united, and empathy reigns. Abundance flows—the trees and plants produce food ready to be eaten, both for humans and animals. Everything comes from the sky and the sea.
We know so much about all the different planetss and space now.
So connected to the cosmos that we begin we have settled what we need to heal here on Earth and we are reaching other timelines in the cosmos and healing ruptured timelines.
Religion is extinct and we all have our our spiritual center. We think about how we fit into the broader ancestral story.
There is an engaged philosophy of the divine.  There are different beliefs–but there is a shared acceptance that there is one “WE.”
There are bees.  Habitat is been protected…the world is greener.  Everything is clean.  There are a lot of insects.

Spiritual healers and shamans are able to access cleaner, more powerful energies from the universe. To accept the self and connect with your own body and spirit. There is deep, strong collective spiritual practice – collective/daily practice nurturing oneness, gratitude and appreciation for all that is life, everyone shares.

We believe without seeing. My faith moves along with the mountains. The supreme force that moves us, yes we can. Calling upon God gives us wisdom to keep evolving. We are living matter, part of creation with ambitions, illusions, and conditions that I would like to be able to affect for the good of humanity. Many people listen to this world. We are open to change. We are part of a just world.
Original of Translation: Creemos sin ver. Mi fe se mueve junto con las montañas. La fuerza suprema que nos mueve, si lo podemos. Llamar a Dios nos da sabiduría para seguir evolucionando. Somos materia viva, parte de la creación con ambiciones, ilusiones y condiciones que quisiera poder afectar para bien de la humanidad. Muchas personas escuchan este mundo. Estamos abiertas al cambio. Somos parte de un mundo justo

Content: If Black was first and became complacent and stopped. God has a plan. His will is the horizon. He moved us into bondage to learn and experience rather than a chosen path. He pushed us into a new beginning, a new horizon; a second chance. Chaos happens all around us because we are not moving in our path. Walk in the light of our destiny and don’t be caught from the back. Lead from the front. Don’t get caught from being  o will be taken over and be forced into another path.

In fact, today, we are welcoming a special person back to our community: The shaman, across all cultures, returns and is a vital function of this horizon as they continue to support spiritual wellness. Because of them, children are intimate with the health of their spirits. When they feel like they've cost themselves or their spirit, they are supported and guided to themselves again. We know our ancestors and they guide us.
We have the love of God watching over us as we care for and respect one another.
Original of Translation: Tenemos el amor de dios cuidandonos el uno al otro y respetandonos.

Content: We have great faith and spirituality.
